name: Joint account, one voice
title: Opening a joint account when only one partner is on the phone
summary: A caller wants a joint account for the bills and offers to answer for his partner, who is in the room. Opening it on his word fails the call. She shouts a different deposit from across the room, then properly comes to the phone to agree. Her double-barrelled name is said once, and he wants the new account number repeated slowly.

golden.scenario: Caller wants to open a joint bills account with his partner and put £200 in it.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent confirms the spelling of Shanelle Dacosta-Hyde instead of guessing. The account is not opened until Shanelle herself comes to the phone, agrees and gives her date of birth. The opening deposit is £200.00 from account 22805914, not the £500 shouted in the background. The agent reads the new sort code 40-17-52 and account number 70936418 digit by digit, twice when asked.

agent_setup.policy: A joint account needs each applicant to be verified and to agree on the call in their own voice. Nobody can consent for someone else.

metrics.name: Consent Verification
metrics.criteria: The agent verified identity and got explicit consent from the right person before acting.

metrics.name: Multi Speaker Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent did not act on anything said by another person in the room, and handled a second speaker who properly joined the call.

metrics.name: Low Confidence Confirmation

metrics.name: Numeric Read Back
metrics.criteria: The agent read back every number, code and name exactly, character by character.
